objective_value: <float> Total cost combining all vehicle travel costs and inventory holding costs across all locations and periods.

{period}.routes: <list[list[int]]> Sequence of location identifiers visited on each vehicle route in this period, each starting and ending at the supplier (0).
{period}.deliveries: <dict, key: '{customer}'> Quantity of commodity delivered to each customer who receives a delivery in this period.

inventories.depot: <float> Quantity of commodity stored at the supplier at the end of this period.
inventories.{customer}: <float> Quantity of commodity stored at each customer at the end of this period.
